title: Crispy Fish Pakora
description: A popular Indian-inspired snack, these crispy fish pakoras are perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillets
ingredients.notes: White fish fillets work best for this recipe

ingredients.name: Indian Spices
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric for authentic flavor

ingredients.name: Pakora Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Indian grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: Gram Flour
ingredients.notes: Also known as chickpea flour, this is a key ingredient in pakoras

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh lemon juice for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Adjust the salt to your taste

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil with a high smoke point

instructions: 1. Cut the fish fillets into small pieces and set aside.
2. In a bowl, mix together the Indian spices, pakora mix, and gram flour.
3. Add the lemon juice and salt to the bowl and mix well.
4. Add the fish pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
5. Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
6. When the oil is hot, add the coated fish pieces to the pan and fry until golden brown.
7. Remove the pakoras from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
8. Serve the crispy fish pakoras hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
